translations.web: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”
translations.bsb: For somewhere He has spoken about the seventh day in this manner: “And on the seventh day God rested from all His works.”
translations.kjv: For he spake in a certain place of the seventh day on this wise, And God did rest the seventh day from all his works.
translations.asv: For he hath said somewhere of the seventh day on this wise, And God rested on the seventh day from all his works;
